title: Just amazing!
body: I downloaded it just from curiosity but it has became a part of my life. I organize my private and work responsibilities and tasks in it. It’s beautifully designed, can really motivate you and let you dive deep into your habit tracking statistics. I also love the tracking of bad habits! It replaced like 5 apps for me, lots of option for customization! I really hope developers will continue to do such an amazing job with it! And the most important, it’s very fairly priced. I just looooooove it!
